Definition: Household cannot afford a meal with meat, chicken or fish, or a vegetarian equivalent, every second day (HE090 = 2). TurkStat codebook wording, identical in 2023–2025: “Haneniz ekonomik olarak; 2 günde bir et, tavuk ya da balık içeren yemeği karşılayabilecek durumda mı? (Vejeteryanlar için eşdeğer yiyecekler)” [Is your household economically able to afford a meal containing meat, chicken or fish every second day? (Equivalent foods for vegetarians)]. Codes 1 = yes, 2 = no; deprived = 2. No recall period: ability to afford at the time of the interview. Missing values: 0 in 2023, 0 in 2024 and 0 in 2025. The household value is assigned to all members.
Source: HE090 (TurkStat microdata, household file); EU-SILC target variable HS050 (Capacity to afford a meal with meat, chicken, fish (or vegetarian equivalent) every second day) in Eurostat coding; in the TurkStat files HS050 denotes a different item

Variable: Low meat, chicken or fish consumption frequency
Definition: Eats meat, chicken or fish less than once a week (code 15); vegetarian or vegan adults (code 19) excluded, and counted as low frequency in a sensitivity analysis. TurkStat codebook wording: “Ferdin son 12 ay içerisinde ferdin et, tavuk veya balık yeme sıklığı” [Frequency with which the person ate meat, chicken or fish in the last 12 months]; codes 1 every day, 2 every week (not every day), 15 less than once a week, 19 never, vegetarian or vegan. Recall period: last 12 months. Frequency of consumption; quantities, intake and diet quality not measured.
Source: MODUL2_F_5 (2025 energy and environment module, person file)

Definition: Eats fruit less than once a day (codes 13, 14, 15, 6). TurkStat codebook wording: “Ferdin olağan/normal bir haftada (7 gün) meyve yeme sıklığı (Konserve veya kuru meyveler dahil olup her çeşit meyve suları hariçtir.)” [Frequency with which the person eats fruit in an ordinary week (7 days); canned or dried fruit included, all fruit juices excluded]; codes 11 twice a day or more, 12 once a day, 13 4–6 times a week, 14 1–3 times a week, 15 less than once a week, 6 never. Recall period: an ordinary week. Frequency of consumption; quantities, intake and diet quality not measured.

Eats vegetables or salad less than once a day (codes 13, 14, 15, 6). TurkStat codebook wording: “Ferdin sebze veya salata yeme sıklığı (patates, çorba ve herhangi bir sebze suyu hariç)” [Frequency with which the person eats vegetables or salad, excluding potatoes, soup and any vegetable juice]; codes as for fruit. Recall period: not stated in the codebook (the same daily and weekly response scale as the fruit item, which refers to an ordinary week). Frequency of consumption; quantities, intake and diet quality not measured.

Medical examination or treatment costs, or medicine costs, were a heavy burden in the last 12 months (code 1 on either item). TurkStat codebook wording: “Son 12 ay içerisinde hanehalkının tıbbi muayene veya tedaviler için yaptığı tüm harcamaların haneye yük getirme durumu” [Extent to which all household expenditure on medical examinations or treatments in the last 12 months was a burden] and “Son 12 ay içerisinde hanehalkının ilaç için (reçeteli veya reçetesiz) yaptığı tüm masrafların haneye yük getirme durumu” [the same for prescribed or non-prescribed medicines]; codes 1 a heavy burden, 2 somewhat of a burden, 3 not a burden, 4 no such expenditure (counted as not heavily burdened). Recall period: last 12 months.
Source: MODUL1_H_1, MODUL1_H_3 (2025 health module, household file)
